_note: Sample data shown when the API has no items. days_ago / time are resolved relative to the viewer's today.
praise_ko: 오늘은 회의에서 영어로 끝까지 말한 문장이 많았어요. 질문할 때 'Could you…'로 시작한 건 아주 자연스러웠어요.

items.original: Yesterday I go to the client meeting and we talk about the launch plan.
items.corrected: Yesterday I went to the client meeting and we talked about the launch plan.
items.natural: Yesterday I went to the client meeting and we talked about the launch plan.
items.explanation_ko: 'Yesterday'처럼 과거를 나타내는 말이 있으면 동사도 과거형(go → went, talk → talked)으로 바꿔요.

items.original: I am agree with your idea.
items.explanation_ko: agree는 그 자체로 동사라서 am을 붙이지 않아요. '동의해요'를 'be + 형용사'로 옮기지 마세요.

items.original: We need to 일정을 좀 미루다 because of the release.
items.corrected: We need to push back the schedule because of the release.
items.natural: We need to push back the schedule because of the release.
items.explanation_ko: '일정을 미루다'는 push back the schedule이라고 해요. postpone도 맞지만 회의에서는 push back이 더 자연스러워요.

items.original: Can you explain me how this API work?
items.corrected: Can you explain to me how this API works?
items.natural: Can you explain to me how this API works?
items.explanation_ko: explain은 사람 앞에 to가 필요해요(explain to me). 주어가 this API(3인칭 단수)라서 works예요.

items.original: I will send you the document until Friday.
items.corrected: I will send you the document by Friday.
items.natural: I'll send you the document by Friday.
items.explanation_ko: 마감 시점은 by, 계속되는 기간의 끝은 until이에요. '금요일까지 보낼게요'는 by Friday.

items.original: We discussed about the budget in meeting.
items.corrected: We discussed the budget in the meeting.
items.natural: We discussed the budget in the meeting.
items.explanation_ko: discuss는 바로 목적어를 받아서 about이 필요 없어요. 특정한 회의는 the meeting.

items.original: Last week I finish the design review.
items.corrected: Last week I finished the design review.
items.natural: I finished the design review last week.
items.explanation_ko: 'Last week'가 있으니 finish → finished. 시간 표현은 문장 끝에 두면 더 자연스러워요.

items.original: I am very interesting in this project.
items.corrected: I am very interested in this project.
items.natural: I'm really interested in this project.
items.explanation_ko: 내가 흥미를 느끼면 interested, 대상이 흥미로우면 interesting이에요.
주어가 she(3인칭 단수)일 때 have는 has가 돼요.

items.original: Two days ago we deploy new version.
items.corrected: Two days ago we deployed a new version.
items.natural: We deployed a new version two days ago.
items.explanation_ko: 'Two days ago'는 과거라서 deployed. 셀 수 있는 명사 version 앞에는 a가 필요해요.

items.original: I am think we need more time.
items.corrected: I think we need more time.
items.natural: I think we need a bit more time.
items.explanation_ko: think는 일반동사라서 am과 함께 쓰지 않아요. 진행형이라면 I'm thinking.

items.original: Let's book meeting room for tomorrow.
items.corrected: Let's book a meeting room for tomorrow.
items.natural: Let's book a meeting room for tomorrow.
items.explanation_ko: 셀 수 있는 명사 하나를 처음 말할 때는 a를 붙여요(a meeting room).

items.original: Please give me a feedback on the draft.
items.corrected: Please give me feedback on the draft.
items.natural: Could you give me some feedback on the draft?
items.explanation_ko: feedback은 셀 수 없는 명사라서 a를 붙이지 않아요. 부탁할 땐 Could you…가 더 부드러워요.

drills.text: Say it: Yesterday I went to the client meeting.
drills.natural: Yesterday I went to the client meeting and we talked about the launch plan.

drills.text: Say it: I agree with your idea.
Say it: Can you explain to me how this API works?
drills.natural: Can you explain to me how this API works?

facts.text: Often keeps the present tense after past-time words like "yesterday" or "last week" — use the past form (went, finished).
Tends to put "am" before verbs ("I am agree", "I am think") — drop "am" with agree, think, and know.

takeaway_ko: 과거 이야기를 할 땐 동사부터 과거형으로. 'yesterday', 'last week'가 들리면 그게 신호예요.

wins.text: Yesterday we finished the demo and sent it to the client.
I agree — let's ship it on Monday.
Can we book a room for the retro?

pronunciation.target: Can you explain to me how this API works?
pronunciation.heard: Can you explain me how this API works?

tips.tip_ko: “to”가 잘 들리지 않았어요. 천천히 또박또박 한 번 더 말해 봐요.
“me” 발음이 조금 불분명했어요. 천천히 또박또박 한 번 더 말해 봐요.
“works?” 발음이 조금 불분명했어요. r: 혀끝이 입천장에 닿지 않게 뒤로 말아요 (l과 구분).
“agree” 발음이 조금 불분명했어요. r: 혀끝이 입천장에 닿지 않게 뒤로 말아요 (l과 구분).
